# rate-limiter-js

Install: npm install @ferrow/rate-limiter-js
> In-memory sliding-window rate limiter

Dead-simple, in-memory rate limiting. Sliding window with minimal overhead. Tracks request counts in a configurable time window and rejects requests that exceed the limit, making it ideal for API throttling and resource budgeting.

## API
- `RateLimiterOptions`
- `RateLimiter`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/FerrowAI.

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
